# Helion

> Helion is an original FPGA family (HL10) and the open-source CAD suite that targets it, written in Rust: synthesis, packing, placement, PathFinder routing, static timing, bitstreams, simulation and hardware debug, in one CLI (`helion`) and one desktop IDE (`helion-ide`). It also targets Lattice iCE40, Lattice ECP5 and Xilinx 7-series parts through backends built on open bitstream documentation. It is not a vendor-tool wrapper.

- Home: https://helion-fpga.github.io/helion/index.html
- Get started (install, build): https://helion-fpga.github.io/helion/start.html
- User guide (IDE, CLI, Tcl, hardware): https://helion-fpga.github.io/helion/use.html
- Architecture (pipeline, crates, HAD parts, constraints): https://helion-fpga.github.io/helion/architecture.html
- Tcl reference: https://github.com/helion-fpga/helion/blob/master/docs/tcl-subset.md
- Benchmarks: https://helion-fpga.github.io/helion/benchmarks.html
- Roadmap: https://helion-fpga.github.io/helion/roadmap.html
- Documentation index: https://helion-fpga.github.io/helion/wiki.html
- Contributing: https://helion-fpga.github.io/helion/contribute.html
- License and legal: https://helion-fpga.github.io/helion/legal.html
- Repository: https://github.com/helion-fpga/helion
- License: AGPL-3.0-or-later
- Build: Rust 1.99.1 (pinned in rust-toolchain.toml); `cargo build --release --locked -p helion-cli -p helion-rune`
- Gold: `helion-ide --headless examples/counter.sv` prints WNS_PS=9640; `helion run examples/counter.sv --cycles 16` prints LED[16]=0000000111111110
- Parts: HL10T-C32-1, HL10T-DSP1, HL10S-C64-1, HL10M-C128-1 (HAD, devices/helion/); ice40-hx8k; LFE5U-85F; xc7a35t (needs the Project X-Ray database)
